problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained convex minimization of f:E→ℝ with an attained minimum. Some minimizer x⋆ satisfies ‖x0−x⋆‖≤R and f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each call at x returns g(x,ξ) using a fresh IID seed. The jointly measurable oracle is unbiased, E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x), and satisfies E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖²≤σ² uniformly in x. Only gradient samples are returned; function values are unavailable.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient exists everywhere and is Fréchet differentiable, with ‖D(∇f)(x)‖≤L0+L1‖∇f(x)‖ for every x. L0>0 and L1≥0; no global Lipschitz-gradient bound is required.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: Finite-variance heavy-tailed gradient noise is permitted. The imported IsLightTailGradient condition is not imposed by this setup.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform additive central second-moment bound σ², with σ≥0. There is no exponential-moment or almost-sure noise bound.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/FiniteVarianceGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: RobustGeneralized.spec.admissible invokes StochasticGradient.IsStochasticGradient; LongTails/Setups/StochasticSmoothAndConvex.lean: IsStochasticGradient.variance_integrable and variance.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a real complete inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure and second-countable topology; finite dimensionality is not required. All parameters are public, including x0, L0, L1, R, Δ, σ, ε and δ. The objective, sampling law and oracle map are hidden. R,Δ,ε>0 and 0<δ<1.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: GeneralizedAccelerated.Public; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: Params; LongTails/Setups/FiniteVarianceGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: RobustGeneralized.spec.Public, publicInput, valid and admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable point-valued output x̂ with f(x̂)−f(x⋆)≤ε on the success event, for a global minimizer x⋆. No particular iterate or averaging rule is prescribed.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: P(f(x̂)−f(x⋆)>ε)≤δ under the joint algorithm and oracle randomness. The extracted budget is a fixed bound on total individual oracle calls, valid for every seed realization.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines gradient-dependent generalized smoothness with merely finite-variance stochastic gradients and a high-probability objective-gap guarantee in a potentially infinite-dimensional Hilbert space.
